newsitem.title: USA: ALPINE SKIING-NYBERG WINS MEN'S WORLD CUP GIANT SLALOM.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-NYBERG WINS MEN'S WORLD CUP GIANT SLALOM.

text.p: Fredrik Nyberg of Sweden made a stirring come-from-behind second run to win the men's World Cup giant slalom in Breckenridge, Colorado, on Saturday.

Fifth after the first run, Nyberg finished with a combined time of 2:11.83, overtaking first-run leader Urs Kaelin of Switzerland, timed in 2:11.99. Hans Knaus of Austria was third in 2:12.03, just ahead of teammate Christian Mayer, timed in 2:12.17. Kjetil Andre Aamodt of Norway was third in 2:12.54.
Winning for the first time in two seasons, Nyberg erased a .45-second advantage with his splendid second run.
